title: Lincoln recalling over 36K vehicles because the passenger’s seat could move on its own - WKBN.com
text:
Car Recall: Lincoln recalling over 36K vehicles due because the passenger's seat could move on its own 
 WKBN.com 
 Lincoln recalling over 36K vehicles because the passenger’s seat could move on its own
 Ann Lipsett 
 2 hours ago 
 (WJW) – Many Lincoln owners are being urged to take their vehicles back to the dealership.
 Lincoln is recalling over 36,000 Navigators from the 2025 to 2027 model years, according to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration . The front passenger seat may move abruptly forward or recline without user adjustment.
 The issue is the vehicle’s “Chauffeur Seat Feature,” which can be controlled through the back seat panel, as residue can trigger the seat adjustments. No injuries have been reported in relation to this recall.
 Drivers who own one of the affected vehicles are being asked to bring it back to the dealer. Technicians at the dealer will then deactivate the Chauffeur Seat Feature, free of charge.
 Recall letters were expected to go out to affected Lincoln owners, according to Car and Drive .
 Drivers who haven’t received a letter or want to double-check if their vehicle is affected can type the vehicle’s VIN, or its year, make and model on the NHTSA website .
